title: claim() denormalization can compute actualPayment==0 while still draining strategies, allowing free claims of small yield
justification: Value leak with stated assumptions: when rewardToken is low-decimal (USDC=6) and per-NFT yield is small enough to floor through the 18->6 denormalization, the strategies are drained to the claimer while actualPayment==0 means safeTransferFrom of zero is collected. Conditions are realistic for USDC reward token on early/small strategies — no owner mistake required. Not High because the loss per claim is bounded by truncation dust at the NFT-supply scale and requires the truncation precondition to bite.
preconditions: rewardToken decimals < 18 (e.g., USDC=6) AND per-NFT yield small enough to truncate to zero after discount.
impact: Free yield extraction up to NFT supply; strategies drained while claimer pays nothing.
attack_path_summary: 1) Reward token has fewer than 18 decimals (USDC). 2) Strategy yield small enough that totalNormalizedYield * (10000-discountRate) / 10000 truncates to 0 in denormalize. 3) NFT holder calls claim(); strategies withdraw to claimer; safeTransferFrom(0) collects nothing; NFT burned but value extracted.
